links.comparator_used: Uncalibrated model probabilities on the SEER test set; the SEER-fit calibrators were also applied unchanged to the METABRIC cohort
links.outcome: Expected Calibration Error (ECE) on the SEER test set after post hoc recalibration
links.effect: Isotonic regression reduced SEER test ECE by 50–92% across all seven models. SEER-fit calibrators applied unchanged to METABRIC increased ECE by a factor of two to three for every model.
links.tradeoff: Calibrators fit on SEER did not transfer to METABRIC because of the base-rate shift (84.7% to 42.1% alive). Per-cohort recalibration on a labeled target sample is therefore needed. The study recommends this but did not test it.
links.quote: Isotonic regression reduced SEER test ECE by 50–92% across all seven models.

design_hint: local recalibration before deployment on target cohort
